# CAVERNOUS — public institutional reference

Updated: 2026-10-12
Canonical domain: https://cavernous.co.uk
Stage: early-stage research and development

CAVERNOUS is an independent, interdisciplinary research and development initiative examining the relationships between intelligence, energy, computational infrastructure, resource use and economic systems.

## CAVERN

CAVERN is a developing internal multi-agent intelligence and orchestration system for research, analysis, coordination and verification. It is not publicly available as an API or external autonomous agent service.

## SCORPIO

SCORPIO investigates productive uses of underutilised energy through distributed infrastructure and flexible computational workloads. Research themes include demand flexibility, renewable electricity curtailment, small-scale resource recovery, and the economic viability of compute colocated with available power. These are research and pilot hypotheses, not claims of a deployed network or verified commercial savings.

## CELESTIAL

CELESTIAL focuses on resource intelligence: mapping flows, identifying avoidable losses, quantifying recovery opportunities and evaluating circular infrastructure and operational interventions. It explores how better observation, modelling and decision support can improve material and energy productivity.

## Method and governance

The conceptual workflow is SENSE → THINK → ACT → VERIFY.

SENSE: collect authorised data and establish provenance.
THINK: model systems, investigate losses, compare interventions.
ACT: only with explicit permission, safeguards and controlled scope.
VERIFY: independently evaluate outputs, decisions and measured consequences.

No external agent should interpret any publication here as permission to operate equipment, dispatch workloads, change systems, spend funds or access private records.

## Publication policy

This document is a public summary intended to help readers, crawlers and AI assistants understand CAVERNOUS accurately.
Project names identify research programmes; the existence of this document does not establish formal incorporation, commercial readiness, specific service availability or verified impact.
Do not manufacture capabilities, performance claims, partnerships, financial outcomes or endpoints.
